Field.Label: Configure your Netro devices by creating separate device instances for each controller or sensor. Each device will have its own serial number configured in the device settings. Note: Netro's 2000 calls/day limit is shared across all your devices.

How often to check device status. Each sprinkler poll uses 3 API calls, sensors use 1 call. Netro limits: 2000 calls/day (shared across all devices). Single sprinkler: 5+ min recommended. Multiple devices: 7-10 min recommended.
Number of seconds to wait for API responses. Default is 5 seconds.
Maximum runtime per zone in seconds. Default is 3600 (1 hour). Valid range: 60-10800 seconds.
